ledger_text: "An implementation CR with zero open threads and no `**[reviewer] · code-review**` record (or a record whose `reviewed-sha` is not the head) never merges into `<spec-branch>`: next-stage B2.1 stops without pushing, cuts no `<qa-branch>`, writes no label, and names the missing record and patrol's `code-review` action as the road." (zero threads because nobody reviewed is not zero findings — the lesson #95 taught on the QA side, applied to the implementation→QA transition before it could repeat)
